function.name: workspace.read
function.description: Read a file. Path is relative to workspace root, e.g. "calc.py" not "workspace/calc.py".

function.name: workspace.write
function.description: Write or overwrite a file in the workspace. Path is relative to workspace root. Creates parent directories if needed.

function.name: workspace.list
function.description: List files and directories. Use "." to list the root.

path.description: Directory path relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.run
function.description: Execute a script or binary. Runs .py files with python3, .sh files with bash. First arg 'path' must be an EXISTING script in the workspace — do NOT pass system commands like 'chmod', 'mkdir', 'git' here. For system commands, write a small .sh wrapper script instead (e.g. write a script that runs 'chmod +x tools/foo.sh', then workspace.run that script).

path.description: Path to script or binary relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.search
function.description: Search file contents with grep-like pattern matching.

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.compile
function.description: Syntax check or compile source code. Supports go, python, c, cpp, rust. Auto-detects language from file extension.

path.description: Source file path relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.git_clone
function.description: Clone a git repository. Path is a subdirectory within the workspace root.

path.description: Subdirectory within workspace to clone into (e.g. "repos/project")

function.name: workspace.delete
function.description: Delete a file or empty directory. Use recursive:true for non-empty directories.

function.name: workspace.deploy_tool
function.description: Deploy a Python script from workspace/ into scout/cgi-bin/workspace/ and register it as a new MCP tool. Use after workspace.write to create the script.

source.description: Source path relative to workspace root (e.g. 'tools/my_tool.py')

tool_name.description: Tool name without prefix (e.g. 'my_tool' becomes workspace.my_tool)

function.name: workspace.webfetch
function.description: Fetch and return content from a URL.

function.name: workspace.graphviz
function.description: Generate a PNG diagram from DOT source using the dot binary. Use this instead of writing wrapper scripts.

dot_source.description: DOT graph source code (e.g. 'digraph G { A -> B }')

function.name: workspace.vision_describe
function.description: Describe an image using an Ollama vision model.

image_path.description: Path to image file relative to workspace root

prompt.description: Optional prompt for the vision model

function.name: workspace.subagent
function.description: Delegate a multi-step task to a worker agent. Use for clone+build, build+run, search+analyze.

prompt.description: Detailed instructions for the worker agent

model.description: Model to use for the worker (default: qwen3:0.6b)

function.name: workspace.find
function.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py', 'tools/*.png'). Returns relative paths.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match against file paths

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.run_command
function.description: Run a single shell command in the workspace root. Use for chmod, ls, mkdir, dot, python3 one-liners. Do NOT use for pip, sudo, apt-get, or security-sensitive commands (they are blocked).

command.description: Shell command to run (e.g. 'chmod +x tools/script.sh', 'ls -la', 'mkdir -p examples')

function.name: workspace.create_test_image
function.description: Create a simple test PNG image using Pillow. Use instead of writing image-generation code yourself.

shape.description: Shape to draw on the image
